0022600139.text: The Golden State Warriors (1-3, 1-2 on the road) are in the fifth game of their 2026-27 season and sit 12th in the West, four games out of... no. The Warriors are 4th in the Pacific, 2 games back, and enter on a one-game winning streak. Minnesota (3-1, 1-0 at home) is 6th in the West and 3rd in the Northwest, 1 game back, and has lost its most recent game after going 3-1 in its first four. Out for the Warriors are Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), while Yaxel Lendeborg is day-to-day with a foot injury and is a game-time decision; Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Golden State lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 127-117 loss in San Francisco on March 13, 2026.
